film.title: A House of Dynamite
film.source: Kathryn Bigelow (dir.), Noah Oppenheim (writer), A House of Dynamite (Netflix, 2025); minute marks read from the film's own clock and are approximate
film.zeroNote: The film's clock opens when the radar sees the missile; the launch, about twelve minutes earlier by the flight time, is not in the film
film.launchNote: Unattributed in the film; a point in the Sea of Japan consistent with a launch from the Korean coast is inferred
film.yieldNote: The film never states a yield. The book's one megaton is borrowed and the readout says so; the 2017 test yield of about 250 kt is the documented alternative

steps.text: A BALLISTIC MISSILE LEAVES THE SEA OF JAPAN · NOT IN THE FILM, PLACED BY THE FLIGHT TIME
SBX-1 IN THE PACIFIC ACQUIRES A BALLISTIC OBJECT · ORIGIN NOT ATTRIBUTED
NORAD ASSESSES · IMPACT POINT CHICAGO · ABOUT NINETEEN MINUTES
THE CONFERENCE FORMS · SITUATION ROOM, NORTHCOM, STRATCOM
FORT GREELY ORDERED TO ENGAGE WITH TWO INTERCEPTORS
THE FIRST INTERCEPTOR FAILS TO LEAVE ITS SILO
STRATCOM PRESENTS OPLAN 8010 AND ADVISES RETALIATION · THE DEPUTY NATIONAL SECURITY ADVISER ADVISES WAITING FOR ATTRIBUTION
THE PRESIDENT HAS NOT DECIDED · THE ORIGIN IS STILL UNKNOWN
THE FILM ENDS HERE, BEFORE THE MISSILE ARRIVES · WHAT FOLLOWS IS THE ENGINE WITH A BORROWED YIELD

book.title: Nuclear War: A Scenario
book.source: Annie Jacobsen, Nuclear War: A Scenario (Dutton, 2024); minute marks from the chapter heads of Parts II to IV, taken from published summaries and to be checked against the text
book.zeroNote: Minute zero is the book's 3:03 pm Eastern launch

slbm.fromNote: The book's submarine 350 miles off California; the position is inferred from that distance

washingtonClaim.label: The book: dead in Washington within minutes

steps.text: 3:03 PM EASTERN · A HWASONG-17 LEAVES SUNAN · SBIRS SEES THE BOOST WITHIN SECONDS
NRO AND NORAD: AN ICBM BOUND FOR THE EAST COAST
NORAD MISSILE CONFERENCE · THE PRESIDENT IS TOLD
FOUR INTERCEPTORS LEAVE FORT GREELY
THE PRESIDENT'S SIX MINUTES · LAUNCH UNDER ATTACK ON THE TABLE
SBIRS SEES A SECOND LAUNCH · A SUBMARINE 350 MILES OFF CALIFORNIA · TARGET DIABLO CANYON
THE PRESIDENT ORDERS 82 WARHEADS AT NORTH KOREA · 50 MINUTEMAN III AND 8 TRIDENT II
TUNDRA SATELLITES SEE THE MINUTEMAN LAUNCHES · SERPUKHOV-15 REPORTS TO MOSCOW
THE GENERAL STAFF READS AN ATTACK ON RUSSIA · THE AMERICAN PRESIDENT DOES NOT CALL
THE STRATCOM COMMANDER ASSUMES LAUNCH AUTHORITY
THE RUSSIAN PRESIDENT, UNREACHED, ORDERS THE FORCE LAUNCHED
THE SECRETARY OF DEFENSE IS SWORN IN AS ACTING PRESIDENT
THE ACTING PRESIDENT ORDERS 975 AIM POINTS IN RUSSIA
MINUTE 72 · THE BOOK ENDS · "HUNDREDS OF MILLIONS" · THE ENGINE RUNS ON TO THE LAST ARRIVAL
